name: mpx/one-column
title: One Column
description: Full-width single-column content section with configurable padding and background (solid colour or optional image). Accepts heading, paragraph, list, checklist, image, video, embed (YouTube etc.), button, subheading, cards, products, Rank Math FAQ, and Fluent Forms blocks.
